## Checklist
- [ ] Branch follows Git flow (`feature/*` → `develop`, `release/*` / `hotfix/*` → `main`)
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` and `npm run lint:specs` pass
- [ ] Affected tests pass locally (`npx playwright test <files>`)
- [ ] No credentials, `.env`, `.auth/` or personal data
- [ ] Bug specs in `tests/bugs/` are linked to their bug report
